Subject: Project GreenWave: Weekly Update & Next Steps

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I just wanted to update you on the progress of our exciting green tech development Project GreenWave:

* So far, we've successfully implemented a sustainable manufacturing process at our new facility that results in a 60% reduction in CO2 emissions.

* Today, we began field testing the product prototype. It is exceeding our quality control thresholds.

* Our design team completed version 8 of the user documentation this afternoon which is already 0.2 versions ahead of its original target launch deadline.

We plan to:
* Complete all testing before March A to gather all final metrics
* Have version 5 complete and sent off for production line approval by early February  to secure manufacturing start.
* Schedule our stakeholder briefing with client C's tech dept next Thurs 4 Feb at 5, so all have latest findings to consider at upcoming Q3 strategic planing. 

We need to factor in the recent power plant grid disruptions, likely reducing supply of rare earth metal X for 5 months - a material key to prototype's magnetic actuators. I recommend:
That we:
• Begin negotiations immediately with our key metals supplier B 
• Start evaluating
